## Task: Prove `endpoint_implies_next_has_left_child` in `/scratch/lelarge/mathcomp-eulerian/psi.v`

### Location
Line 3404 of `psi.v`:

```coq
Axiom endpoint_implies_next_has_left_child :
  forall (k : nat) (w : seq nat),
    uniq w -> k.+1 < size w -> ~~ is_internal k w ->
    has_left_child k.+1 w.
```

### Definitions
- `is_internal i w := (i < size w) && (1 < window_size i w)` (line 3264)
- `has_left_child i w := has_left_child_fuel (size w) i w` (line 1623)
- `has_left_child_fuel` (line 1609): recurses on tree structure via `mm_pos`. At root `j`: if `i == j` then `0 < j` (has left child iff root is not at position 0); otherwise recurse into left/right subtree.
- `window_size_fuel` (line 93): at root `j`: if `i == j` then `size s - j`; otherwise recurse.
- An endpoint has `window_size k w = 1` (it's a leaf in the min-max tree).

### Mathematical idea
If vertex k is an endpoint (leaf) and k+1 exists, then k+1 has a left child. Why: in the min-max tree, vertex k is a leaf. The in-order successor k+1 must be an ancestor of k (or a node whose left subtree contains k as its rightmost leaf). Therefore k+1 has a non-empty left subtree, hence has a left child.

More precisely, by induction on the tree:
- Let `j0 = mm_pos w` (root)
- If `k < j0` and `k+1 < j0`: recurse in left subtree `take j0 w`
- If `k < j0` and `k+1 == j0`: then root j0 has left subtree (of size j0 > 0 since k < j0), so `has_left_child j0 w = (0 < j0) = true`
- If `k > j0` and `k+1 > j0`: recurse in right subtree `drop j0.+1 w` with adjusted indices
- `k == j0` case: if k = j0 is an endpoint, then `window_size j0 w = size w - j0 = 1`, so `size w = j0 + 1`. But then `k.+1 = j0.+1 = size w`, contradicting `k.+1 < size w`.

### Build
The project uses `_CoqProject`. Compile `psi.v` with `coqc` using flags from `_CoqProject`. Imports: `From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect` and `Require Import mmtree`.

### Instructions
1. Change the `Axiom` to a `Lemma` with proof
2. You'll likely need helper lemmas about `window_size_fuel` and `has_left_child_fuel` — check what already exists in the file
3. Use strong induction on `size w`
4. Make sure the file compiles
5. Do NOT modify any other axioms or proofs

### Don't-repeat-these-mistakes
- `sorted_leq_nth` side conditions need `rewrite inE`
- Use `!nth_psi_left //` not `(nth_psi_left Hlt)`

Lemma endpoint_implies_next_has_left_child :
  forall (k : nat) (w : seq nat),
    uniq w -> k.+1 < size w -> ~~ is_internal k w ->
    has_left_child k.+1 w.
Proof.
move=> k w; move: w k.
have Hind : forall n k w, size w <= n ->
  uniq w -> k.+1 < size w -> ~~ is_internal k w ->
  has_left_child k.+1 w.
  elim => [|n IH] k w Hsz Huniq Hk1 Hep.
    by move: Hk1; rewrite leqn0 => /nilP ->.
  case: w Hsz Huniq Hk1 Hep => [//|a s0] Hsz Huniq Hk1 Hep.
  set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
  have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
  have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
  have Hj2 : j <= size s0 by rewrite -ltnS.
  (* Unfold is_internal in Hep *)
  have Hk_lt : k < size s.
    by apply: ltn_trans Hk1; exact: ltnSn.
  have Hws_k : window_size k s <= 1.
    move: Hep; rewrite /is_internal Hk_lt /= negbK.
    by rewrite -leqNgt.
  (* Case split on k vs j *)
  case: (ltngtP k j) => [Hkj | Hjk | Hkj].
  - (* k < j *)
    case: (ltngtP k.+1 j) => [Hk1j | Hk1j | Hk1j].
    + (* k.+1 < j: both in left subtree, recurse *)
      rewrite (has_left_child_cons k.+1 a s0) -/s -/j.
      rewrite Hk1j.
      have Htake_sz : size (take j s) <= n.
        by rewrite size_take Hj; rewrite -ltnS;
           exact: leq_trans Hj Hsz.
      have Huniq_t : uniq (take j s).
        have : uniq (take j s ++ drop j s)
          by rewrite cat_take_drop.
        by rewrite cat_uniq => /andP [? _].
      have Hk1_t : k.+1 < size (take j s)
        by rewrite size_take Hj.
      have Hep_t : ~~ is_internal k (take j s).
        rewrite /is_internal size_take Hj Hkj /=.
        rewrite (window_size_cons k a s0) -/s -/j Hkj.
        by rewrite -leqNgt.
      exact: IH _ _ Htake_sz Huniq_t Hk1_t Hep_t.
    + (* j < k.+1: impossible since k < j implies k.+1 <= j *)
      by move: Hkj; rewrite ltnS leqNgt Hk1j.
    + (* k.+1 = j: root has left child since 0 < j *)
      rewrite (has_left_child_cons k.+1 a s0) -/s -/j.
      rewrite ltn_eqF; last by rewrite Hk1j.
      by rewrite Hk1j eqxx; rewrite -Hk1j.
  - (* j < k: both k, k.+1 in right subtree *)
    have Hjk1 : j < k.+1 by exact: ltn_trans Hjk (ltnSn k).
    rewrite (has_left_child_cons k.+1 a s0) -/s -/j.
    rewrite (ltn_eqF Hjk1); last first.
    rewrite ifN; last by rewrite ltn_eqF.
    (* Recurse on drop j.+1 s with adjusted indices *)
    set dw := drop j.+1 s.
    have Hdw_sz : size dw <= n.
      rewrite /dw size_drop /s /=.
      by rewrite -ltnS (leq_ltn_trans _ Hsz) //
         leq_subr.
    have Huniq_dw : uniq dw.
      rewrite /dw; move: Huniq.
      rewrite -{1}(cat_take_drop j.+1 s) cat_uniq.
      by move=> /andP [_ /andP [_ ->]].
    have Hk1_shift : k.+1 - j - 1 = (k - j - 1).+1.
      have : j < k by exact Hjk.
      by rewrite subSn // subnS succnK.
    rewrite Hk1_shift.
    have Hk_shift_lt : (k - j - 1).+1 < size dw.
      rewrite /dw size_drop.
      have : k.+1 < size s := Hk1.
      rewrite /s /= => H.
      rewrite -Hk1_shift.
      apply: ltn_sub2r; last exact H.
      exact: ltnW Hjk1.
    have Hep_dw : ~~ is_internal (k - j - 1) dw.
      rewrite /is_internal.
      have Hk_dw : k - j - 1 < size dw.
        by apply: ltn_trans Hk_shift_lt; exact: ltnSn.
      rewrite Hk_dw /=.
      rewrite (window_size_cons k a s0) -/s -/j.
      rewrite (ltn_eqF Hjk) ifN; last by rewrite -leqNgt ltnW.
      by rewrite -leqNgt.
    exact: IH _ _ Hdw_sz Huniq_dw Hk_shift_lt Hep_dw.
  - (* k = j: endpoint at root is impossible *)
    exfalso.
    have Hws_j : window_size j s = size s - j.
      by rewrite (window_size_cons j a s0) -/s -/j ltnn eqxx.
    have : size s - j <= 1 by rewrite -Hkj.
    have : 1 < size s - j.
      rewrite -Hkj ltn_subRL addnC /=.
      by rewrite Hkj.
    by move=> H1 H2; move: (leq_ltn_trans H2 H1); rewrite ltnn.
- move=> k w Huniq Hk1 Hep.
  exact: (Hind (size w) k w (leqnn _) Huniq Hk1 Hep).
Qed.

The proof proceeds by strong induction on `size w` with three main cases based on how `k` relates to the root position `j = mm_pos w`:
